title: Mid-Term Plan Changes on Residential Electricity Supply: Authorization Card
content:
**Rule.** A mid-term plan change on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle and the new term is counted from that date, at the plan-change rate determined for the agreement rather than the price-sheet offer: a customer moving an agreement mid-term is re-priced from the contract rate already in force on it.

The customer authorizes a mid-term plan change personally, because it replaces the terms of their contract.

The plan-change rate is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry a rebill credit for every over-billed energy line whose correction is within the care agent's adjustment limit.

A plan change is not recorded until the sign-up credit the current plan has earned stands on the agreement's bill lines.

**Business effect.** A recorded plan change replaces the agreement's plan, term length and contract rate, sets the date the new plan takes effect and the new contract end date, and leaves the agreement active.

## Authorization action

**Capability.** `change_plan_fbee8941` records the account holder's personal authorization of a mid-term change of one of their Beacon Ridge residential electricity agreements to another plan. The agreement's plan name, term length, contract rate, the date the new plan takes effect and the new contract end date are replaced by the values given, and the agreement stays active.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the care agent unlocks `change_plan_fbee8941` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the change.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number being changed, as read from the agreement lookup for the caller's premise | Identifier |
| `variant_name` | The official name of the plan the agreement moves to | Exactly one of: `Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24`, `Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12`, `Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12`, `Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24` |
| `term_months` | Length of the new plan's term | Whole number of months, no decimals |
| `contract_rate_cents_kwh` | The supply rate of the new plan | Cents per kWh to 2 decimal places (for example 10.25), no currency sign |
| `plan_change_date` | The date the new plan takes effect | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `contract_end_date` | The last day of the new plan's term | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |

The plan names correspond to the month-to-month variable plan, the six-, twelve- and twenty-four-month price locks, the twelve-month time-of-use plan with free nights, and the twelve- and twenty-four-month wind-matched plans.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the agreement number, the new plan, the rate in cents per kWh, and the new plan's start and end dates. Receiving it means the change is recorded on the agreement.
